title: Port Alberni Mill
geometryBasis: Three named native CanVec-derived OSM building polygons provide 68 edge controls. Their location and use are confirmed by the named paper mill parcel and operator address.
sectionBasis: Foundation skirts follow the unchanged coastal DEM grade. The 1970 EPA aerial supports the industrial vocabulary. The operator and 1999 permit describe later boiler and papermaking functions used to scope the current core.
limitations: Current individual bay heights, colors, roof divisions and equipment placements are estimated. The 1970 image predates later processing changes and does not establish present equipment count.
One tall common boiler stack and representative smaller vents illustrate the documented later process layout. The model does not reconstruct vanished Kraft lines or the historic log-boom yard.
The three named mapped industrial buildings are the model scope. Outlying buildings, clarification ponds, shore handling and interiors remain outside it.
